_note: Synthetic data for an educational SOC 2 readiness concept. Not a real assessment.

rules.title: Vendor creation and payment approval
rules.rationale: One person can create a payee they control and then approve money moving to it. This is the classic fictitious-vendor fraud path and the reason vendor master maintenance is kept away from payment release.

rules.title: Payment initiation and approval
rules.rationale: Self-approval removes the second pair of eyes entirely — the person submitting the payment is the person releasing it, so no independent check on amount, payee, or validity ever happens.

rules.title: Vendor creation and payment initiation
rules.rationale: Even without approval rights, a single person able to add a payee and queue a payment to it controls both sides of the setup and relies entirely on the approver catching an unfamiliar vendor name.

rules.title: Production deployment and direct database write
rules.rationale: Someone who can both ship code and edit production data directly can make a change and then alter the records that would reveal it, defeating the change management trail.

rules.title: Self-approved production change
rules.rationale: Approving your own change and then deploying it means no independent review ever occurred, which is exactly what the change management criterion is designed to prevent.

rules.title: Journal entry posting and approval
rules.rationale: The person recording an entry should not be the person approving it; otherwise a misstatement can be both created and blessed by the same individual without detection.

rules.title: Account creation and access approval
rules.rationale: Holding both lets a person grant themselves or a colleague entitlements and sign off on the request, so the approval record proves nothing.

rules.title: Entitlement change and access approval
rules.rationale: Privilege escalation becomes self-service: the administrator who changes entitlements is also the control that is supposed to authorize the change.

rules.title: Compensation change and payroll execution
rules.rationale: One person can change a compensation record and then pay it out, with no independent review of the change before money leaves.

rules.title: Bulk data export and entitlement change
rules.rationale: A person who can widen their own access and bulk-export merchant records can assemble a confidential dataset without anyone approving it.
